**Microsoft FY2024 gross margin (fiscal year ended June 30, 2024)**

Both inputs come from the same statement in the same filing and are on the same fiscal-year basis (year ended June 30, 2024), so no comparability adjustment is needed.

Calculation:
- Revenue: $245,122 million [DOC-1: "Fiscal year ended June 30, 2024: Revenue $245,122; Cost of revenue $74,114."]
- Cost of revenue: $74,114 million [DOC-1: "Fiscal year ended June 30, 2024: Revenue $245,122; Cost of revenue $74,114."]
- Gross margin = $245,122M − $74,114M = **$171,008 million**
- Gross margin percentage = $171,008 / $245,122 = **69.8%**

For context, FY2023 gross margin was $211,915M − $65,863M = $146,052M, or 68.9% [DOC-1: "Fiscal year ended June 30, 2023 (prior-year comparative): Revenue $211,915; Cost of revenue $65,863."] — an increase of roughly 0.9 percentage points year over year.

ANSWER: $171,008 million (69.8% of revenue)
